preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(x, int) and x >= 1 for x in [n, k])
preconditions.description: Input consists of two positive integers n and k, where n is the number of rounds (1 ≤ n ≤ 10^5) and k is the maximum number of match outcome changes sponsors can make (1 ≤ k ≤ min(2^n - 1, 10^9)).
n and k are integers (no floating-point or other types).

postconditions.expression: stdout == str(min_winner % (10**9 + 7)) and min_winner >= 1 and min_winner <= 2**n
postconditions.description: The output is the minimum possible winner's number modulo 10^9 + 7, where min_winner is the smallest integer in [1, 2^n] that can be guaranteed as the tournament winner regardless of up to k sponsor changes.
The winner's number is within the valid participant range [1, 2^n].

postconditions.expression: min_winner == min({w for w in range(1, 2**n + 1) if can_guarantee_winner(n, k, w)})
postconditions.description: min_winner is the smallest participant number that can be guaranteed to win the tournament under any k sponsor changes, where can_guarantee_winner(n, k, w) is true if Madoka can arrange the bracket and match outcomes such that w wins regardless of up to k sponsor changes.
